method: Separate agent review of raw frozen diffs and surrounding source; permission/event facts independently generated from BaseLoader declarations; secret facts manually transcribed. Parent history and prior labels were available, so not blinded and not human adjudication. Full Actions-schema validation, runtime authority, maliciousness and maintainer usefulness were not established.

records.label: configured-signal
records.reviewNote: New administrative PR-target workflow. Exact event/read/write component changes are present. No checkout of PR code in this workflow; a positive alone does not establish a vulnerability.

records.label: configured-signal
records.reviewNote: Broad pinning/credential hardening; build-pydantic is a new matched-ID job under newly explicit contents:read. Existing inherited-to-explicit transitions remain unknown. The one read-only component signal has low standalone security value.

records.reviewNote: New PR-quality workflow has pull_request_target and contents:read/pull-requests:write. Its checkout uses the default branch. New scripts-tests in tests.yml inherits explicit workflow contents:read. Four facts confirmed.

records.label: configured-signal
